name: Green Team and Coastal Cleanup Volunteers
what_you_do: Help care for the park by weeding, mulching and removing leaves, or pick up trash from salt marshes and beaches and log what you find. Staff give you tools and training.
who_can_apply: All ages can join. Teens under 16 must be with a parent or guardian the whole time, so teens 16 and up can volunteer on their own. Event volunteer roles are usually 18 and up.
duration: Green Team: twice a month on Saturdays, 10 a.m. to noon, April to October. Coastal Cleanups: about 2 hours each, now and then from April to October. Sign up for as many as you like.
deadline_text: No deadline. Sign up for each event. Most activities run April to October. 2027 dates are not posted.
how_to_apply: Make a Volunteer Profile with the Volgistics link on the park's volunteer page. Then pick events.
notes: Coastal Cleanup is best suited for ages 10 and up. Tasks happen outdoors on uneven ground. Ask staff about accommodations.
